summary: ChipMOS Technologies filed a Form 6-K furnishing its August 2026 unaudited consolidated revenue release. The Taiwanese OSAT (TWSE: 8150, Nasdaq: IMOS) reported NT$2,785.7 million, or US$88.0 million at NT$31.67/US$1, down 1.3% month-over-month but up 33.3% year-over-year, citing AI-driven memory demand. No transaction, board recommendation, advisor, price, stake, or structural mechanic is disclosed. This is a routine monthly operational update equivalent to a US current report on Form 8-K; no special situation or deal terms are present.
